title: Puffco Hot Knife Preheated Loading Tool
description:
The Puffco Hot Knife is an electronic heated tool that makes loading your concentrates an easy task. Dip the Hot Knife into your concentrates to scoop out a dose and then heat the tip to let the oil drop into your atomizer or banger. When you are done just place the cap back over the tip. Never again will you have to worry about sticky residue or dirty dab tools.

ALSO AVAILABLE
YOCAN BLADE
UTILLIAN WAX AXE

The Hot Knife tool measures 5.25 inches long and is capable of 50 or more uses on a single charge. Includes a USB-C charger and can charge in as little as 30 minutes.

Puffco Hot Knife Features:
Compatible with Concentrates
Size: 5.25″ Tall (with Cap)
Electronically-Heated Ceramic Tip
Easy to Clean (Alcohol Moistened Cotton Swab)
No Other Tools Required
USB-C Charging (Cable Included)
500mA Battery (30mins to Charge — 50+ Uses per Charge)

How The Puffco Hot Knife Works:
Just hold down the button, and your oil drops right off in 3 seconds
Lasts at least 50 or more uses per charge
Caution – tip gets very hot – use the cap to store when finished
To clean, press the button to warm and wipe surfaces with a cotton swab

What’s in the Box:
1x – Puffco Hot Knife Tool
1x – USB-C Charging Cable
